'''2017 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship in Princeton, New Jersey, 6–8 January 2017. [[Jonny Chu]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/match-play-championship/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Princeton, New Jersey
* '''Dates:''' 6–8 January 2017
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
